notes: Portal guide refresh: a provider push-back mid-walk (a limit answer without a retry hint, or a server error) now pauses that provider for five minutes and resumes where it left off instead of re-logging in, so a guide refresh no longer trips the provider's request limiter and other devices keep their sessions. Transport errors retry the same session; a plaintext rejection re-arms once per pass; an empty page after rows were gathered is trusted as the end.
